senses.gloss: ch. same, to look out; to hope.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 18:43">Targ. I Kings XVIII, 43</cite>.
Targ. O. Gen. XXXI, 49 יִסְךְ ed. Berl. (oth. ed. יִסַךְ, יִסְכֵּי; Y. יִסְתְּכִי Ithpe; h. text יצף). Targ. Y. ib. XLV, 28.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 20:22">Targ. Prov. XX, 22</cite>; a. fr. (interch. with <cite ref="O00090"><he>סבר</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:7">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>סְכִי בי אסתכל בי</he> (the poor man says) look at me, observe me; <he>סכי כי מה הוינא וכ׳</he> look at me (think) what I was, and observe what I am. Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵇ <he>סְכוֹן מיעול וכ׳</he> look out (be on your guard) that you come in while it is yet day-time; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 4:4:4">Y. R. Hash. IV, 59ᶜ</cite> top <he>סבין מטול ומיעול</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 47:13">Targ. Is. XLVII, 13</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 62b">Keth. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>הוות מְסַכְּיָא וכ׳</he> his wife was looking out (for him, saying,) now he is coming &c.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 105:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. CV, 38</cite> [read]: <he>חמרא מַסְכֵּי … מיני ואיהו מסכי וכ׳</he> the ass was looking (hoping), when will he get down off me?, and he was looking, when shall I get down &c.; a. e.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 166b">B. Bath. 166ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>אֲסוּכֵי מַסְכֵּי וכ׳</he> Rashi (ed. <cite ref="M01948"><he>מסכן</he></cite>, read: <he>מַסְכּוּ</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he (they) would count them (the P’rutahs) and state their amount in Zuzé.

senses.gloss: same, to look, face; to hope, wait.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 15:5">Targ. O. Gen. XV, 5</cite> (Y. <he>אסתכל</he>; h. text <he>הבט</he>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 21:20">Targ. O. Num. XXI, 20</cite> <he>מִסְתַּכְּיָא</he> (ed. Berl. <he>מִסְתַּכְיָא</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 37:32">Targ. Ps. XXXVII, 32</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97b:2">Snh. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>עד הכא לא תִסְתְּכֵי ליה … אִסְתְּכִי ליה</he> until that time do not hope for him (the Messiah), after that hope for him; a. e.
